race.comment: HELLO LOVELY (8) looks the best after her solid second-up run at Doomben, finishing second in BM65 on soft ground, just two lengths away at long odds. Now tackling 1400m, where she boasts one win and six placings from twelve starts, the easier conditions bolster her winning chances. KOBABILITY (9) was overlooked in the market when finishing ninth in a BM65 at Eagle Farm, but she won a BM58 at the Sunny Coast prior and has the class to bounce back at 1400m. BODMIN MOOR (5) comes off a CL1 win at Lismore and should be at his top now. Will be interesting to see how the apprentice handles the wide draw. Blinkers go on to STAR OF ASCOT (7) who can improve with the shades off sound recent efforts.
